# Standard interoperability fixtures

These identities are public, synthetic test data and must never protect user data.
`x25519.age` and `hybrid.age` were generated and decrypted by the actual Standard
`core/Clash.Meta/component/age/age.go` implementation using its fixed engine
`github.com/metacubex/age v0.0.0-20260603010618-28d156b4ea78`.
`provenance.json` records the source hash and fixture hashes. The test payload is
`profile.yaml`; no real subscription, user identity or credentials are included.

The shared helper's third-party license bundle includes age and its dependencies.
